_comment: The fork-ci release (.github/scripts/fork-ci-release.py, fork-ci/README.md). paths: the only files a release commit holds (fork-kit: host kits, installed from a release commit; the desk and heavy kits also read the fleet scripts and the capacity rule files listed here), at the same paths as on sourceBranch; fork-ci-release.test.py fails when a kit installer reads a file outside them. legacyTags: tags made before release commits existed (they name a sourceBranch commit, not a release commit, and stay where they are).
